title:
Got your keys.
*When can you sell?*

lines.say: You just got your keys. When can you actually sell?
lines.cap: got your keys. *when can you sell?*

lines.say: HDB flat? Five years. That's the minimum occupation period.
Before that, you can't sell or rent out the whole flat.
lines.cap: before that: *no sale, no full rental*

lines.say: Private home bought from July 2025? You can sell any time, but seller's stamp duty applies for four years.
Bought an EC? It has its own minimum occupation period, so check your project's terms.
Plan your next move around these dates, not after.

caption:
Just got your keys? Here's when you can actually sell. 🔑

HDB: 5 year minimum occupation period. Before that, you can't sell or rent out the whole flat.
Private (bought from July 2025): sell any time, but seller's stamp duty applies for four years.
EC: has its own MOP, so check your project's terms.

Plan your next move around these dates, not after.
